description: This file defines an abstract base class 'GrainService' for implementing grain-like partitioned services within Orleans. It manages lifecycle events such as start, stop, and handling ring range changes, and integrates with the Orleans runtime infrastructure using dependency injection, logging, and ring range subscriptions.

classes.name: GrainService
classes.description: An abstract class providing lifecycle management, range handling, and runtime integration for a partitioned grain-like service in Orleans.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initialization hook for the grain service, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins service startup, retrieves the ring range, logs the start, and initiates background startup tasks.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the service, cancels ongoing operations, logs the shutdown, and updates status.

methods.name: OnRangeChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the ring range owned by the service, updating internal state and incrementing serial number.
